description: DOORS is a Roblox horror game by LSPLASH where you team up to get through a hotel full of hostile entities, opening door after door. Codes give free Knobs, Revives, Boosts and sometimes Stardust, which you can spend in the lobby shop.
redeemSteps: Open DOORS and stay in the Lobby. Codes can't be redeemed during a run.
Click the Store tab at the bottom of the screen.
Go to the Codes section of the Store.
Paste the code into the box and confirm. Copy codes exactly, including any spaces.
